mapper.select: SELECT t.receivable_id, t.tenant_id, t.customer_id, t.customer_name, t.contract_id, t.contract_no, t.receivable_no, t.receivable_name, t.planned_amount, t.received_amount, t.outstanding_amount, t.due_date, t.received_date, t.invoice_status, t.invoice_id, t.owner_id, t.owner_name, t.remark, t.status, t.del_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, c.dept_id AS scope_dept_id, c.owner_id AS scope_owner_id FROM oa_crm_receivable t INNER JOIN oa_crm_customer c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id AND c.del_flag = '0' WHERE t.receivable_id = #{receivableId} AND t.del_flag = '0'
